oir_ccrc.name: Florida Office of Insurance Regulation, Continuing Care Retirement Communities map

scope.naples: Collier County cities (Naples and Marco Island) plus other Collier locations that are not Bonita Springs, Estero, or Fort Myers.
scope.nearby: Bonita Springs, Estero, and Fort Myers only. Cape Coral, Lehigh Acres, North Fort Myers, and Alva are not on this list.

excluded.in_review: Applications still in review are not listed, because they are not licensed.
excluded.out_of_area: Licensed facilities in Cape Coral, Lehigh Acres, North Fort Myers, and Alva are outside the nearby cities named for this list.
excluded.oir_cape_coral: Gulf Coast Village is on the official OIR life-plan list but is in Cape Coral, so it is not included here.
